commands.name: board.list
commands.description: List the boards in KanZen, e.g. "what boards do I have".

commands.name: board.read
commands.description: Read a KanZen board with its columns and cards, e.g. "what is on my work board". Without a board it reads the open one.

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: card.list
commands.description: Find cards on a KanZen board, e.g. "what is overdue" or "what is in the doing column".

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

text.description: Words to look for in card titles and descriptions

limit.description: Most cards to return, at most 50; 20 if left out

commands.name: card.add
commands.description: Add a card to a KanZen board, e.g. "add a card to call the plumber to my to do column". The person approves it before it appears.

column.description: Column name; leave out for the board's first column

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: card.move
commands.description: Move a KanZen card to another column, e.g. "move the plumber card to done". The person approves it before it moves.

card.description: The card's title, or part of it

board.description: Board name; leave out for the open board

commands.name: proposal.status
commands.description: Check KanZen changes waiting for approval, e.g. "did my card get added". Give a proposal_id for one change, or nothing for all that wait.

proposal_id.description: The proposal_id that card.add or card.move returned
